request.spec: Every client needs an email. Do not let me save one without a proper email address.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read CLAUDE.md — it states the working rules, the project layout, and the data-testid
conventions. Follow it.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Every client needs an email. Do not let me save one without a proper email address.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, and any audit records it
expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as you work;
iterate until it passes. Implement the full-stack change (database migration + OfficeFloor
server + front-end). Do NOT edit the pinned scaffolding (bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop,
bin/e2e, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md) or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
All 3 tests pass. The change is implemented as a full-stack, additive change with validation at all three layers:

**Front-end** (`features/clients/`)
- `email.ts` (new) — one definition of "a proper email address" (`local@domain.tld`, no whitespace).
- `ClientForm.tsx` — on submit, blocks when the email is blank or malformed, surfacing `data-testid="client-form-email-error"` and not creating a row; a valid email POSTs and clears the error. Typing in the email field clears a shown error.

**Server** (`ClientsPostLogic.java`)
- Validates the email with the same rule and rejects an invalid body with `HttpException(BAD_REQUEST)` before it reaches the repository — so the API can't save a bad client either.

**Database** (`db/migration/V2__clients_email_required.sql`, new)
- Adds a `CHECK (email LIKE '%_@_%._%')` constraint as the matching last line of defence.

The existing `email` column was already `NOT NULL`; the new constraint additionally enforces the *shape* (rejecting `''` and values without an `@`/domain). No pinned scaffolding, the test spec, or applied migrations were touched. Frontend `typecheck` passes and all three Playwright tests (blank, malformed, valid) pass.
